L66: Lennox International Set to Join S&P 500 and BILL Holdings to Join S&P MidCap 400
L67:   *   *   *   *   *   *   * NEW YORK, Dec. 18, 2024 /【37†PRNewswire†www.prnewswire.com】/ -- S&P MidCap 400 constituent Lennox International Inc. (NYSE: LII) will replace Catalent Inc. (NYSE: CTLT) in the S&P 500, and BILL Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BILL) will replace Lennox International in the S&P MidCap 400 effective prior to the opening of trading on Monday, December 23. Novo Holdings A/S has acquired Catalent in a deal that closed today, December 18.
L68: Following is a summary of the changes that will take place prior to the open of trading on the effective date:
L69: Effective Date  | Index Name        | Action  | Company Name  | Ticker  | GICS Sector
L70: Dec 23, 2024  | S&P 500  | Addition  | Lennox International  | LII  | Industrials
L71: Dec 23, 2024  | S&P 500  | Deletion  | Catalent  | CTLT  | Health Care
L72: Dec 23, 2024  | S&P MidCap 400  | Addition  | BILL Holdings  | BILL  | Information Technology
L73: Dec 23, 2024  | S&P MidCap 400  | Deletion  | Lennox International  | LII  | Industrials

L83: S&P Dow Jones Indices is the largest global resource for essential index-based concepts, data and research, and home to iconic financial market indicators, such as the S&P 500® and the Dow Jones Industrial Average®.
